verdict.rationale: Morph hosts open-weight chat models and specialized models through an API, so a deprecation policy for hosted models is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no documented deprecation policy, notice period or model-retirement schedule. The community remark that only an older model is listed on OpenRouter says nothing about deprecation notice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice before a hosted model is removed
